steps.en: Company hirer gets an e-reminder email or has opted out
steps.id: Hirer company menerima e-reminder email atau sudah opt out
steps.why_en: The e-reminder job is switched off in the production settings, so no reminders go out there.
steps.why_id: Job e-reminder dimatikan di setting production, jadi tidak ada reminder yang terkirim di sana.

steps.en: Notice with a due company hirer is picked for checking
steps.id: Notice hirer company yang jatuh tempo dipilih untuk dicek

steps.en: The company UEN is sent to the data source for lookup
steps.id: UEN company dikirim ke sumber data untuk dicari
steps.why_en: The job that sends the UEN is switched off in production, and the repo never names a source called DOS.
steps.why_id: Job yang mengirim UEN mati di production, dan repo tidak pernah menyebut sumber bernama DOS.

steps.en: Company board and shareholder data is fetched
steps.id: Data board dan shareholder company diambil
steps.why_en: No person name or address is fetched, and the job is switched off in production.
steps.why_id: Nama dan alamat orang tidak diambil, dan job-nya mati di production.

steps.en: Person chosen by offence date and term of appointment
steps.id: Pemilik/partner/director dipilih menurut tanggal offence dan masa jabatan
steps.why_en: Nothing compares the offence date with the person's appointment dates, so no one is picked this way.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang membandingkan tanggal offence dengan masa jabatan orang, jadi tidak ada yang dipilih dengan cara ini.
